observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The lens cap is black with 'Canon' written on it. The camera body has 'Canon' branding visible. The lens appears to be a standard zoom lens, not a dedicated kit lens.
Photo 1: Rear view of the camera showing the LCD screen, control buttons (MENU, INFO, Av, SET, etc.), and the 'Canon' logo on the bezel. The screen is off and reflects surroundings.
Photo 2: Side view of the camera showing the 'EOS 100D' model name engraved on the body. The lens is attached, and the camera appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD'.
